definition: Run 87 (REJECTED probe; measured monthly gas, no coal flags): the EIA-923 ISO-month gas series reprices the merit order month-by-month. Two findings. (1) Coal-gas split: OVER-corrects — fixes 2024 coal (lignite -23.8->+1.2, PRB -9.9->+10.8) but overshoots (PRB +8.3/+10.8/+1.3) and worsens the gas classes harder (CT_PEAKER 2024 -23.1 vs keeper -12.8, ST_GAS 2024 -12.7 vs -2.7); 2024 ledger coal +12.5 TWh, gas -9.7; Martin Lake plant guard tripped (+1.42/+1.97/+1.51 vs CAMPD). The structural answer is NOT simply the gas path. (2) LMP: confirms the scarcity diagnosis — 2023 MAE improves 30.9->28.5 (winter months lift the level) but the 2023 summer >=$200 scarcity tail still carries ~100% of the residual (mid-curve now slightly OVER-prices), and 2025 MAE degrades 11.7->17.5. Keeper stays run 79.
